import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Initialize the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a point plot
sns.pointplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', dodge=True)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Type')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
